description: Amphibious anti-submarine aircraft of Baltic Fleet naval aviation, the museum's only aircraft. Wears bort 07 yellow. Maritime museum on the Pregolya embankment with a fleet of museum ships including the submarine B-413 and the research vessel Vityaz. Free access to the open-air areas. Data from the russianplanes.net museum register (museum 262). Construction number 0602002.
